item.title: IHTML 1.1 — element connections, meshes with bones and hair with physics
item.description: New IHTML editor version 1.1. Elements connect to each other without code, sliders drive the timeline, video and sound, meshes bend with several bones and hair falls with physics in one click. More stable and more secure.
